PROPERTY_PAYMENT_CONFIG.TITLE: Property payment configuration
PROPERTY_PAYMENT_CONFIG.DESCRIPTION: Set receiving methods, deposit policy, and bilingual instructions for the currently managed property.

SECTIONS.ACTIVATION_HELP: Choose an explicit environment before validating or enabling payments.
SECTIONS.METHODS_HELP: Enable only methods the property can reconcile and support.
SECTIONS.BANK_HELP: The account number is encrypted by the server and only a masked value is returned.
SECTIONS.DEPOSIT_HELP: The server calculates payable amounts from the saved policy.
SECTIONS.INSTRUCTIONS_HELP: Provide Vietnamese and English copy so guests always receive the right instructions.

STATES.SELECT_PROPERTY_BODY: Use the property selector in the page header to load its payment configuration.
STATES.LOADING_BODY: Checking property access and payment readiness.
STATES.LOAD_ERROR_TITLE: Payment configuration could not be loaded

READ_ONLY.TITLE: Read-only access
READ_ONLY.BODY: This account can view readiness but cannot change payment configuration.

MESSAGES.ERROR_TITLE: The request could not be completed
MESSAGES.REQUEST_FAILED: Payment configuration could not be processed. Please try again.
MESSAGES.VALIDATION_READY: Validation complete: the configuration is ready in the selected environment.
MESSAGES.VALIDATION_BLOCKED: Validation complete: the configuration still has blockers to resolve.

ACTIONS.SAFETY_NOTE: Validation does not send money. Production remains locked until separate approval and valid secrets are present.

ENVIRONMENT_HELP.SIMULATOR: Internal test flow with no real-money transaction.
ENVIRONMENT_HELP.PRODUCTION: Live environment requiring separate approval and complete secrets.

PROPERTY_PAYMENT_CONFIG.PRODUCTION_GATE: Production is fail-closed. Selecting it does not authorize real-money collection.

FORM.ENABLED_HELP: Enable only after readiness validation has no blockers.
FORM.SECRET_PLACEHOLDER: Leave blank to keep the current value
FORM.TRANSFER_TEMPLATE_HELP: Keep {paymentCode} so every payment receives unique transfer content.

READINESS.READY_BODY: The configuration meets the current environment requirements.
READINESS.BLOCKED_BODY: No payment is sent while a readiness blocker remains.
READINESS.METHODS_OK: At least one valid method is enabled

PRIVACY.TITLE: Sensitive data is protected
PRIVACY.BODY: The UI never returns full account numbers or merchant references after saving.

BLOCKERS.CONFIGURATION_NOT_SAVED: The configuration has not been saved.
BLOCKERS.ENABLED_METHOD_REQUIRED: Enable at least one payment method.
BLOCKERS.BILINGUAL_INSTRUCTIONS_REQUIRED: Both Vietnamese and English instructions are required.
BLOCKERS.PAYMENT_EXPIRY_INVALID: Expiry must be an integer from 1 to 10,080 minutes.
BLOCKERS.FIXED_DEPOSIT_INVALID: A fixed deposit must be a positive integer VND amount.
BLOCKERS.PERCENTAGE_DEPOSIT_INVALID: Deposit percentage must be an integer from 1 to 100.
BLOCKERS.MERCHANT_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: A merchant reference is required for this method.
BLOCKERS.PRODUCTION_ENDPOINT_IS_SANDBOX: A production endpoint cannot point to sandbox.
BLOCKERS.PRODUCTION_PROFILE_REQUIRES_PRODUCTION_M: The production profile requires production mode.
BLOCKERS.UNKNOWN: One configuration requirement is still unmet.
